148:t_105:3.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「Silence, $$サルディアス・アクス$$! That way of yours... targeting even people's hearts to win...!」

148:t_105:4.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「I feel such disgust...! It's like being forced to look at my former self!」

148:t_105:5.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Ah... so that's it. But in that case, your anger is misdirected.」

148:t_105:6.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「I wasn't the one who devised the operation to break the hearts of the people of $$新日本$$.」

148:t_106:0.en:
$$ヒイロ$$
「I have confirmed the attack target...」

148:t_106:1.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「My, you're quite the professional. I can tell you've been through quite a few deadly situations, despite your youth.」

148:t_106:2.en:
$$ヒイロ$$
「I have no intention of talking to the enemy. I'll eliminate you at once.」

148:t_106:3.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「...Of course. Then I'll devote myself to my duties as well.」

148:t_107:0.en:
$$竜馬$$
「You sure went to a lot of trouble! I'll pay you back in full for everything you've done!」

148:t_107:1.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「My, my... That's gracious of you. If you were that pleased, all my efforts to set things up were worthwhile.」

148:t_107:2.en:
$$竜馬$$
「You can try to bamboozle me with that talk, but it won't work!」

148:t_107:3.en:
$$竜馬$$
「Here I come, $$サイデリアル$$! I'll hit you with the anger of $$新日本$$'s people on their behalf!」

148:t_107:4.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Ha ha... That Japanese sentimentality is precisely what made our operation succeed, you know...」

148:t_108:0.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「In terms of efficiency, your operation can only be called brilliant.」

148:t_108:1.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「I'm deeply honored by your praise.」

148:t_108:2.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「But personally, I can only call it repulsive. I reject anyone who makes reopening old emotional wounds part of their tactics...!」

148:t_108:3.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Well... that is a natural reaction. I have no intention of making excuses.」

148:t_108:4.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「It's a pity. If you have that much decency, I wish you'd stayed true to it...!」

148:t_108:5.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「But it's too late now...! You've made me angry!」

148:t_109:0.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Fate is a curious thing... I never imagined I'd fight someone from the $$アストラギウス$$ Galaxy here.」

148:t_109:2.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「My apologies... This isn't the time for small talk.」

148:t_109:3.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Then I'll carry out my mission without delay as well.」

148:t_110:1.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「If you understand the difference in our strength, hurry up and wave the white flag. You don't want to die, do you?」

148:t_110:2.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「I know. You say such noble things, but you've always lived with despair.」

148:t_110:4.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「No, I won't shut up. If you ask me, you're living a better life, since you can still have hope.」

148:t_110:5.en:
$$スズネ$$
「This overwhelming emotion... Hatred that engulfs everything...」

148:t_110:6.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「If you won't obey us, I'll just free the $$いがみ合う双子$$ $$スフィア$$ right away...!」

148:t_110:7.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「Before that, I'll paint over the hope and despair inside you with nothing but despair!」

148:t_111:0.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「$$バルビエル・ザ・ニードル$$! I'll strike you down myself!」

148:t_111:1.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「I like that naked hatred. You're a lot like me.」

148:t_111:2.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「It's true that I once lived with hatred, and hurt the people dear to me because of it...!」

148:t_111:3.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「To make sure I never suffer those regrets again, I won't fight out of hatred!」

148:t_111:4.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「That's ridiculous. If you don't fight out of emotion, what meaning does your battle have?」

148:t_111:5.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「The meaning of my battle... is the hope entrusted to me! That's why I... why $$ゼロ$$ exists!」

148:t_112:0.en:
$$ティエリア$$
「That battle at $$セントラル・ベース$$ in North America...」

148:t_112:1.en:
$$刹那$$
「We were defeated by the power of that man, $$バルビエル$$...!」

148:t_112:2.en:
$$ティエリア$$
「Unless we defeat him, the war engulfing the world won't end! Let's go, $$刹那$$!」

148:t_112:3.en:
$$刹那$$
「We are $$ソレスタルビーイング$$...! We fight to eradicate war from this world!」

148:t_113:0.en:
$$ロックオン$$
「Just you wait, $$バルビエル$$!」

148:t_113:1.en:
$$アレルヤ$$
「The poison that machine released all but wiped out the $$連邦軍$$ fighting alongside us...!」

148:t_113:2.en:
$$ピーリス$$
「And that man's power to amplify hatred drove the military organization to the brink of collapse...!」

148:t_113:3.en:
$$ロックオン$$
「We're paying you back right here! Get ready, you scorpion bastard!」

148:t_114:0.en:
$$グラハム$$
(Young man... I'll fight alongside you...)

148:t_114:1.en:
$$グラハム$$
(And one day, I'll proudly call myself your comrade-in-arms...!)

148:t_114:2.en:
$$コーラサワー$$
「Relax, $$ライトニング$$. If you get too worked up, the Grim Reaper will come for you.」

148:t_114:3.en:
$$グラハム$$
「That's what I'd expect of $$コーラサワー$$ the Immortal. Thank you for the advice.」

148:t_114:4.en:
$$コーラサワー$$
「Anyway, once you're dead, it's all over! Let's stay alive and fight to the end!」

148:t_114:5.en:
$$コーラサワー$$
「And we'll pay that scorpion bastard back for North America!」

148:t_114:6.en:
$$グラハム$$
「I understand! I, $$グラハム・エーカー$$, am attacking!」

148:t_115:0.en:
$$スメラギ$$
($$バルビエル・ザ・ニードル$$... The Scorpio $$スフィア・リアクター$$...)

148:t_115:1.en:
$$スメラギ$$
($$ガドライト#pilot$$ was part of $$サイデリアル$$ too, and there's that man, $$尸空#pilot$$...)

148:t_115:2.en:
$$スメラギ$$
(Just how many more $$リアクター$$s does $$サイデリアル$$ have...?)
